name: Black Bear Creek
source:
Becca and Danny have been together since high school and are finally moving in together. Money’s tight, so they end up in a cheap little apartment in Black Bear Creek. Not the nicest area, but they are together. That’s all that matters.

Becca loves Danny. As far as she’s concerned, their relationship is perfect. She’s never really wondered if she’s missing out on anything. Their sex life is pretty good too! Becca isn’t one of those girls that can orgasm from sex, but she still enjoys making Danny feel good.

The neighbours are a different story. Loud, cocky… dark. Exactly the type her dad told her to stay away from. Tyrone next door is a perfect example. He is so crude and disrespectful. To make things worse, the walls of their apartment are paper-thin and every night Becca and Danny hear these ridiculous moans from the never-ending line of girls that seem to come and go from his apartment.

Becca and Danny laughs it off. They think its funny because the girls are obviously faking it. No one actually sounds like that during sex.…Right?

[From [url=https://www.blackbearcreekgame.com/]the official website[/url]]
translation:
贝卡和丹尼从高中起就在一起，终于搬到了一起。由于资金紧张，他们最终住在黑熊溪的一套廉价小公寓里。不是最好的地区，但他们在一起。这才是最重要的。

贝卡爱丹尼。在她看来，他们的关系是完美的。她从来没有真正想过自己是否错过了什么。他们的性生活也很美好！贝卡不是那种可以从性中达到高潮的女孩之一，但她仍然喜欢让丹尼感觉良好。

邻居们的情况则不同。大声、自大……黑暗。这正是她父亲告诉她要远离的类型。隔壁的蒂龙就是一个很好的例子。他是如此粗鲁和无礼。更糟糕的是，他们公寓的墙壁像纸一样薄，每天晚上贝卡和丹尼都会听到那些似乎从他的公寓进进出出的女孩永不停歇地发出的可笑的呻吟声。

贝卡和丹尼一笑置之。他们认为这很有趣，因为女孩们显然是在假装。实际上没有人在做爱时听起来像这样……对吗？
